milestones.title: MOVR Data Hub (MOVR 1.0)
milestones.text: MDA's registry across 7 diseases and 60 sites. Data collection ended in 2025; the data remains available for approved research.

milestones.title: MOVR 2.0 pilot
milestones.text: Families living with SMA, DMD and LGMD tested competing platforms side by side. Enrollment is closed.

milestones.title: Technology partner selected
milestones.text: MDA selected a technology partner for MOVR 2.0, informed by the pilot.

milestones.title: MOVR 2.0 recruitment opens
milestones.text: Recruitment for the full MOVR 2.0 launch opens. The disease communities included will be announced with it.

pilot.title: MOVR 2.0 pilot
pilot.intro: Families living with SMA, DMD and LGMD walked through every step of joining MOVR 2.0 from home, on three platforms run side by side. Enrollment is closed.
pilot.population: Participants in the MOVR 2.0 pilot (SMA, DMD and LGMD), 2025 – 2026. Pilot participant counts are shown as ranges
pilot.source: MOVR team pilot records, reported November 2026

steps.title: Create an account
steps.text: Sign up from home on a phone or computer, with no clinic visit needed.

steps.title: Baseline survey
steps.text: A short survey about the participant and their diagnosis. We are validating it before launch.

steps.title: Consent
steps.text: Each participant agrees under a strict, IRB-approved study protocol, knowing what their data is for.

steps.title: Authorize records
steps.text: Participants connect health records from the care sites they've visited, so past records and new data can follow.

pilot.groups_intro: We approached each advisor individually before any data arrived, and each group worked from a charter with clear objectives.

groups.title: Clinical
groups.text: Defined the clinical use case and judged whether the data looked like a real patient.

groups.title: Data integration
groups.text: Set the expectations for extraction, mapping, data standards and quality.

groups.title: Patient advocacy
groups.text: Brought the community's view, including how disease subtypes get lost in records.

movr1.title: MOVR Data Hub (MOVR 1.0)
movr1.population: MDA MOVR Data Hub Study participants with validated enrollment (a record in demographics, diagnosis and encounters), excluding USNDR legacy participants
